company.name: EIDSIVA ENERGI AS
company.summary: EIDSIVA ENERGI AS is a private limited company (aksjeselskap) registered under distribusjon av elektrisitet (NACE 35.140), based in Hamar, founded 2001-05-24. Its verified website describes it as: “Eidsiva sørger for at samfunnet og du er på.” Public brand: Eidsiva. Registered activity: Virksomhet i tilknytning til produksjon, distribusjon, lagring, omsetning og anvendelse av energi, bredbånd og annen infrastruktur, og virksomhet som står i forbindelse med dette, herunder ivaretagelse av morselskapsfunksjoner i Eidsiva-konsernet og drift og forvaltning av konser. Latest filed accounts (2025-01-01 to 2025-12-31, company accounts): revenue NOK 187.0 m, operating result NOK -126.0 m, net result NOK 1.1 bn, total assets NOK 56.4 bn, equity NOK 35.1 bn. The period closed with a profit. Change from 2024 to 2025: revenue went from NOK 207.0 m to NOK 187.0 m (-10%); net result went from NOK 941.0 m to NOK 1.1 bn (+19%); equity went from NOK 35.6 bn to NOK 35.1 bn (-1%). Financial position in 2025: operating margin -67.4%; equity ratio 62.2%. Calculated from the filed figures above. Registered employees: 101. Leadership in the official register: Henning Olsen (managing director); Liv Monica Bargem Stubholt (chair of the board); Sidsel Trætteberg (board member); Per Luneborg (board member); plus 14 further roles. 4 registered workplaces in Gjøvik, Hamar, Lillehammer, Oslo. Official website https://www.eidsiva.no (identity check: labelled organisation number); company-linked profiles on facebook, instagram, linkedin. Latest company-published activity: “41 jenter tok over Trehørningen for en dag” (2026-11-11). Most recent registry event: Registered employee count updated (2026-10-13). Not established from checked sources: active job ads (not available). Missing information is not treated as zero.
